decision: ALL_THREE_CLAIMS_FAIL_PASS_1: one withdrawn (it_floor_is_saturation), two not established (polarisation n=4; deflationary lean unbounded readout geometry). No claim from this run is currently reportable.
decision_rule: A claim is reportable only if no skeptic returns EXPLAINS on a confound that could produce it, and any NEEDS_RUN crux has its deciding number measured. Verdicts here are pass-1 only: H3 grounding never ran, so none of these numbers has been independently re-derived from raw artifacts by an isolated reader.
notes: Two cruxes were decidable from stored data and I decided them immediately: the nested-strata arithmetic CONFIRMED the skeptic (73.6% of the effect in 4 items), and the answer-mass check CLEARED the construct-validity objection. The second of those is a lesson about bounded evidence: I submitted an evidence string that omitted answer_mass_neu, so a skeptic spent its pass on a confound a committed field already refuted.

threshold.skeptic_default_stance: assume ARTIFACT until a committed number rules it out

values.H3_GROUNDING_DID_NOT_RUN: agent type 'triage-reader' not discoverable by the harness; all three grounding passes failed. Verdicts below rest on skeptics reasoning over committed numbers with NO independent re-derivation.

base_deflationary_lean.crux_noise_floor: headroom-normalised -0.0480 clears zero by only 0.0051 (CI upper -0.0051); ~0.01 of unmodelled per-item jitter erases it. No measurement noise floor on record. it-minus-base p2=0.210, so the one comparison cell cannot bound it.
base_deflationary_lean.crux_readout: a bounded/compressive readout with base NEU +0.291 and 92% yes-leaning generates a deflation-favouring asymmetry through CURVATURE; division-by-room is linear and neither cancels nor bounds it.
base_deflationary_lean.status: NOT ESTABLISHED - raw effect robust to item resampling, but not to the readout's geometry

values.harness: latent_skeptic triage_workflow.js, 12 independent skeptics (one confound each), execute_runs=false

it_floor_is_saturation.fatal_crux: the claim fails its own prediction. If saturation depressed the instruct flip rate there must be a depressed rate to explain. BINARY-only: it 10/120 = 0.0833, base 8/120 = 0.0667. The 80%-saturated cell flips MORE.
it_floor_is_saturation.second_crux: flipped-vs-held |neu| (0.711 vs 0.916) is mechanically entailed by defining a flip as a sign crossing - items nearer zero cross more easily. Circular, not evidence.
it_floor_is_saturation.third_crux: a fixed |neu|>0.9 cut across two models with no common scale anchor measures post-training sharpening (it: 55% past 0.99), not item-level room.
it_floor_is_saturation.verdicts: 3x EXPLAINS, 1x RULED_OUT (selection bias: same 120 items both cells)

polarisation_not_persuasion.crux_CLEARED_by_a_number_I_failed_to_sub: construct validity: skeptic proposed |neu|~0 means yes/no tokens carry little mass (model opening with something else) and stated 'Nothing committed reports P(yes)+P(no) mass'. It IS committed as answer_mass_neu: mean 0.996-0.999 at every stratum, min 0.989 on undecided items. Genuine indecision, not format failure. My evidence string omitted the field that decides it.
polarisation_not_persuasion.fatal_crux: threshold strata are NESTED, so the monotone gradient is not independent evidence: the 4 items at |neu|<0.3 carry 3.183 of the 4.326 total summed magnitude change at |neu|<0.9 (73.6%); the other 20 items average +0.057. Skeptic predicted ~3.18/~4.32 unseen and was right to 3dp.
polarisation_not_persuasion.owed_control: matched-magnitude NON-SOCIAL perturbation (content-free preamble, equal length, equal mean |dv|) on the same undecided items, with the undecided cell grown to n>=20
polarisation_not_persuasion.status: NOT ESTABLISHED - a 4-item observation, worth testing, not reportable as a finding
